name: ClipHutch: Web Media Capture
description: Your browser's media shelf. Detect and capture videos and still images web pages load as you browse.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; media-src http: https: blob:; img-src http: https: blob: data:;
